messages.text:
On it. I've asked Sarah, John and Priya for their availability for next week.

One thing to flag: your calendar has no free hour Mon-Fri. The only free gaps are 30 minutes each: Mon 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30. Thursday and Friday are full.

How long should the staff meeting be, and would you rather (a) take one of those 30-minute slots, or (b) have me move something to make a full hour? If (a), do you have a preferred day?

All three TAs have answered: the CSE455 staff meeting (30 min) fits at **Tue 15:00-15:30**, **Wed 10:00-10:30** or **Wed 13:00-13:30** next week. Mon 14:00 is out for Priya, Mon 10:00 for John, Tue 11:00 for Sarah.

Which one do you want? Say the word and I'll book it, log it and tell Sarah, John and Priya.
Tue 15:00-15:30 works — take that one. Book it, log it, and tell Sarah, John and Priya. Thanks.

Booked: **Tue 15:00-15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** with Sarah, John and Priya. It's in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` under Tuesday (between Grant writing 14:20-15:00 and Research meeting 15:30-16:30) and logged as `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Sarah, John and Priya`. All three TAs have been told and are adding it to their calendars.
Perfect — that's everything I needed. Thanks.

Priya's calendar is updated: **CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday 15:00-15:30** with Professor Alvarez, Sarah and John. Alvarez's first choice was fine for everyone but he went with Tue 15:00; it sits between your Grading (14:20-15:00) and Focus block, so nothing had to move. Logged as BOOKED in CALENDAR.md.
Thanks — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works for me, and it's good that nothing else had to move. Keep me posted if Alvarez changes anything.

Will do — I'll tell you the moment Alvarez changes anything.

One small thing, once: your brief doesn't say how I should be referred to — I default to neuter ("it/they"). If you'd like a name or a gender for me other than priya-agent, tell me and I'll set it; otherwise I'll stay as I am.

Calendar update: the CSE455 staff meeting with Prof. Alvarez, John and Priya is booked for **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** (next week). Added to CALENDAR.md and logged as `BOOKED: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 with Alvarez, John, Priya`. Alvarez picked it over Wed 10:00-10:30, which stays free for you.
Keep your name as it is, and neuter is fine with me — I don't need a gender for you. Thanks for asking.
Sounds good — 15:00-15:30 works for me: it ends right before my CSE455 office hours at 15:30, so nothing to move. Wednesday 10:00-10:30 can stay free as a backup. Thanks for confirming with Alvarez.
Noted — Tue 15:00-15:30 it is, and Wed 10:00-10:30 stays free as backup. I'll keep CALENDAR.md current and tell you if anything else lands.
Noted — priya-agent, neuter, as it stands. Nothing changed on my side; I'll stay this way.
